mn17:5.4: ‘While living close by this jungle thicket,
mn17:24.7: But I didn’t go forth from the lay life to homelessness for the sake of a robe, not for the sake of almsfood … not for the sake of lodgings … not for the sake of medicines and supplies for the sick.
mn17:24.8: Moreover, while living supported by this individual, my mindfulness does not become established, my mind does not become immersed in samādhi, my defilements do not come to an end, and I do not arrive at the supreme sanctuary from the yoke.’
mn17:25.7: But I didn’t go forth from the lay life to homelessness for the sake of a robe, not for the sake of almsfood … not for the sake of lodgings … not for the sake of medicines and supplies for the sick.
mn17:25.8: Moreover, while living supported by this individual, my mindfulness becomes established, my mind becomes immersed in samādhi, my defilements come to an end, and I arrive at the supreme sanctuary from the yoke.’
